EmailTemplate.description: Missing app fee, transcripts or both.
EmailTemplate.name: Incomplete Application
EmailTemplate.subject: We’re missing items to complete your application
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
As your personal admission counselor at Arizona State University, I am here to help you through the admission process, and I noticed your application is still incomplete.
If you haven't already done so, please activate your My ASU page at http://my.asu.edu/ so you can review your application status and take care of any Priority Tasks needed to complete your application.
Currently, you are missing the following item to complete your application and receive an admission decision:
<<CHOOSE ONE BULLET POINT OPTION FROM BELOW>>
Pay your application fee. You can submit your application fee online through My ASU at http://my.asu.edu/ or by sending a check or money order to:
Admission Services Arizona State University P.O. Box 870112 Tempe, AZ 85287-0112
Send us your official transcripts. Have your school send your official transcripts to:
Admission Services Arizona State University P.O. Box 870112 Tempe, AZ 85287-0112
Pay your application fee and send us your official transcripts. You can submit your application fee online through My ASU at http://my.asu.edu/ or by sending a check or money order to Admission Services. Have your school send your official transcripts to Admission Services to the address below.
Admission Services Arizona State University P.O. Box 870112 Tempe, AZ 85287-0112
If you have any questions about this process, or if there is anything I can do to help, please let me know.
Sincerely,
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
